title: feat(spec)!: retire the list view's filterableFields — declared as the userFilters.fields shorthand, read as a Filter-panel whitelist; no per-view whitelist replaces it
body:
Fixes #24640

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What

`filterableFields` retires from the list-view shape under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, on the maintainer's ruling C (record 6278975049, verbatim 「C」), pulled into 18.0 (record 6279033298, verbatim 「提前」). The key carried two meanings. The spec described it as the legacy shorthand for `userFilters.fields` (the quick-filter bar), and the Studio view form offered it as "Field names available for filtering". Its one renderer, objectui's `ListView` (the `filterFields` memo), read it as the Filter panel's field whitelist. The ruling is that the platform carries no per-view Filter-panel whitelist, so **no key replaces it**.

- **Tombstone.** `filterableFields: retiredKey(LIST_VIEW_FILTERABLE_FIELDS_RETIRED)` sits in `ListViewShapeSchema`, beside `searchableFields`. Every door built from the shape refuses the key with the prescription: `tsc` types it `never`, and the parse raises the prescription instead of a bare unknown-key report. The prescription says: delete the key, no per-view Filter-panel whitelist replaces it; for a curated end-user filter bar declare `userFilters: { element: 'dropdown', fields: [{ field: 'FIELD_NAME' }] }`; the Filter panel offers every field the user may read (field read security decides, and a field the object marks `hidden: true` is not offered). It closes with the house `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence.
- **Studio form.** The `filterableFields` input leaves `view.form.ts`, with a comment in its place. The four extracted form-label bundles are regenerated (pure deletion).
- **ADR-0087.** The D2 conversion `view-list-filterable-fields-removed` (protocol 18, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`) **drops** the key from every list payload in `stack.views[]`, in all three persisted spellings. It never rewrites it to `userFilters.fields`. The D3 entry is `list-view-filterable-fields-retired`. `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains `ui/ListView:filterableFields` and `ui/ObjectListView:filterableFields`. The step-18 rationale gains one fragment.
- **Ledger.** The `view.json` row `/props/list/children/filterableFields` flips `live` to `dead`. It keeps the tombstone discipline (`verifiedAt` 2026-10-19, `evidenceScope: cross-repo`) and carries a REMOVED note naming the one reader the ruling makes unreachable. `state-counts/view.md` is regenerated: live 79 to 78, dead 11 to 12.
- **Docs.** The `os:check` example on `content/docs/concepts/architecture.mdx` stops teaching the key. It declares a `userFilters` dropdown on `industry` instead, because the example meant a user-facing filter. The reference pages are regenerated.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/24640-list-view-filterable-fields-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, with a BREAKING banner, a FROM to TO table, the one-line fix and a stored-row paragraph. It carries the Clause-② line and the ADR-0087 marker `registered view-list-filterable-fields-removed, list-view-filterable-fields-retired`. Release arithmetic, measured: `.changeset/pre.json` is `{ "mode": "exit", "tag": "next" }` and the spec label is `18.0.0-next.5`. A minor increment of that prerelease is `18.0.0`, so the next version pass publishes this in 18.0.0.

## Premises, each with its reading (base `bfc1539fe0`; re-read after merging `origin/main` `1c1144fcd8`)

**P1 holds.** One declaration exists: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (was `:2844`) on `ListViewShapeSchema`. `ObjectListViewSchema` is `ListViewShapeSchema.omit({ userFilters }).extend(...)`, so one tombstone covers both. Both `authorable-surface/ui.json` rows (`:757`, `:944`) now read `[RETIRED]`. Inside `packages/spec/src`, `git grep -c filterableFields` at base hit 4 files: the declaration, the form row and two pins. No schema outside the list-view family declares the key. The other carriers are the same family. The flattened overlay arms are built from the shape. `ListViewPageProps` (a page `list-view` node, `ComponentPropsMap['list-view']`) spreads `ListViewSchema.shape`. The react `ListView` block's schema is `ListViewSchema`, and its curated `dataProps` never listed the key (see the Acceptance notes for the react-page boundary).

**P2 holds, and the census found more readers than the card listed.**
- Zero authors, each with a lit control on the same instrument at base. `git grep -c` for `filterableFields`, then `searchableFields` (control), then `userFilters` (control):

  | corpus | `filterableFields` | `searchableFields` | `userFilters` |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | `examples/**` | 0 | 2 | 7 |
  | `packages/apps/**` | 0 | 0 | 0 |
  | `packages/qa/**` | 0 | 2 | 0 |
  | `skills/**` | 0 | 20 | 12 |
  | `packages/platform-objects/**` | 4 | 12 | 21 |

  The 4 `platform-objects` hits are the four generated translation bundles, regenerated here.
- `packages/create-objectstack` reads 0 for all three keys. Its templates author no list view at all, so that zero is uninformative beyond that fact.
- Beyond the card's list, these mention the key without authoring it:
  - `packages/lint`: the list-view field-ref rule's role and severity maps and its fixtures, `REACT_FIELD_SPECS.ListView`, the field-consumer vocabulary, and two `rule-explanations` sentences;
  - `packages/metadata-core`: the ADR-0106 field-security scrub's `LIST_VIEW_NAME_LISTS`;
  - `packages/metadata-protocol`: `computeViewReferenceDiagnostics`, a raw-input read;
  - `packages/objectql`: that read's fixtures.
- None of those is an author. All are outside this card's file surface and are left in place (Acceptance notes). The tree-scoped pin carries the four files that spell it as an object key as self-expiring RESIDUE.

**P3 holds.** The mechanism is the one the closest 18.x list-view retirement used (`view-list-tabs-removed`), with the strip shape of 17.x `view-list-passthrough-keys-removed`.
- **Entries.** One `retired-keys/18.ui__ListView__filterableFields.ts` and one `18.ui__ObjectListView__filterableFields.ts`, registered per key as gate (b) reads them. One D3 `semantic/18.list-view-filterable-fields-retired.ts`, per family.
- **Conversion order.** The conversion is inserted into `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` where its identifier sorts, with `order: 71`. It is defined directly above `viewListTabsRemoved`. `scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` is green.
- **Rationale.** The `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment sorts by id, with `order: 105`. `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` is green.
- **`retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`** is the newest published stable. `retired-after.census.json` is untouched: it is generated from published tarballs, and its last census release is `17.4.0`. Under the label `18.0.0-next.5`, `retired-after.census.test.ts` admits `[17.4.0, 18.0.0)`.
- **The pin's JOIN row.** `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` requires a JOIN row for every retired entry at the newest stable, so one row is added.
- **Disposition.** `check-adr-0087-registration` passes with `registered` (both ids new here). `no-migration-prescription` would refuse itself, because the changeset carries a FROM to TO table.
- **Not a semantic mapping.** The machinery asked for a conversion. It is a drop, so this premise did not fail.

**P4 holds.** Every generated artifact moved by its own tool:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` wrote `authorable-surface/ui.json` (2 rows to `[RETIRED]`);
- `gen:docs` wrote 3 reference pages;
- `gen:liveness-counts` wrote `state-counts/view.md`;
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` wrote the 4 `platform-objects` bundles;
- `gen:migration-registry` wrote the gitignored registry.

Hand-written, by design: the ledger row (measurement prose, no generator) and the `registry.ts.template` fragment. `authorable-surface.base.json` is untouched. After the merge of `origin/main`, `check:generated` reads "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".

## Mechanism assumptions G1 to G5, measured

- **G1.** `ui/view-list-filterable-fields-retirement.test.ts` pins the refusal at **eight** doors:
  - `ListViewSchema`;
  - `ObjectListViewSchema`;
  - `ViewSchema` `list`;
  - `ViewSchema` `listViews.*`;
  - a `ViewItemSchema` record's `config`;
  - the `view` write door's flattened overlay;
  - `ObjectSchema` `listViews.*`;
  - a page `list-view` node's `properties`.

  Each pin checks issue code `invalid_type`, the path naming the key, and the prescription. Each door has two lit controls: the same body without the key parses, and the same body with `userFilters: { element: 'dropdown', fields: [...] }` plus `searchableFields` parses. The tsc channel is pinned too (`@ts-expect-error` compiles under the test-layer typecheck), and the parse throws the same prescription.
- **G2.** The form row is gone, pinned by a walk of `viewForm` with anti-vacuity neighbours. The bundles are regenerated and `check:i18n` passes.
- **G3.** `architecture.mdx` is rewritten. `check:skill-examples` reports "262 prose examples type-check".
- **G4.** As above. The derived changeset gates were run on the final head (Gates).
- **G5.** Every consumer suite is green (Tests). No fixture in those packages authors the key through a parse, so none needed re-truing. The lint and objectql fixtures that spell it feed raw-input walks and still pass.
  - One out-of-lane pin had to move. It is a count, not a fixture: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`, where the metadata-form catalog drops 674 to 673. The removed input took its label out of all three locales.
  - That edit is a cross-lane rider, listed for the seat to declare.

## Ablation (the tombstone is what shuts every door)

The fix was committed first. Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, in wrap mode under its own restore trap plus an outer `trap` on the absolute path, the tombstone line was swapped back to the pre-retirement declaration `filterableFields: z.array(z.string()).optional()`.
- **Mutation on disk:** anchor count 1 to 0 and replacement count 0 to 1. The blob moved from `1e5e34e05ab8` to `d38c1ae00383`, and an in-command `grep -c` read 1 and 0.
- **Run:** `vitest run` of the new pin plus `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` went **red, the predicted direction**. 13 failed and 71 passed.
- **What failed:**
  - all 8 door refusals;
  - the empty-array refusal;
  - the prescription content;
  - the tsc-channel parse;
  - the object-`listViews` boundary, whose object now parses;
  - the removal-version JOIN row.
- **What held:** every control and boundary acceptance, and every D2 conversion pin. Those pins are independent of the shape.
- **Restore:** the blob after restore equals HEAD (`1e5e34e05ab8`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tests import `src` by relative path, so no `dist` leg applies.

## Tests (consumer packages `--maxWorkers=2`, under `os-verify-lock.sh`)

- `@objectstack/spec` `local`: 702 files, 21352 passed (1 todo). Run at `c0c1a8ad33` and again on the merged head `bb71914fc9`.
- `@objectstack/spec` `repo` project: 64 of 71 files, 1039 passed, on `bb71914fc9`. The new pin is 1 of the 64.
  - The other 7 are the build and publish tooling tests (`build-console-objectstack-root`, `build-schemas-check-mode`, `dist-freshness*`, `publish-smoke-*`, `published-projection-choke-point`). They outlast the foreground cap on this shared box, so they are NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI's `Test Core`.
- `@objectstack/spec typecheck` passes, on the merged head too.
- `@objectstack/lint`: 148 files, 6935 passed, on the merged head.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 79 files, 1195 passed, on the merged head; its typecheck passes.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 249 files (3 skipped), 20771 passed.
- `@objectstack/objectql` `local`: 448 files, 8447 passed.
- `@objectstack/rest` `local`: 300 files, 6095 passed (326 skipped).
- `@objectstack/runtime` `local`: 425 files in three batches, 6671 passed (19 skipped).
- `@objectstack/cli` `unit`: 314 files in four batches, 4641 passed. The `integration` layer is declared to CI.
- These five were run at `c0c1a8ad33`, before the merge. The merge brought no new `filterableFields` mention: `git grep -c` per file is identical at base and at `origin/main`.
- Every example app runs `os validate` and `os build` (`app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase`, `app-multi-package`), and all pass. `embed-objectql` has no validate script.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out-of-lane readers left in place, for the seat's follow-up.** Each reads the key off raw input and none delivers anything once the parse refuses it. This matches the reasoning of the `tabs` retirement's stage 2: the lint suite judges the parsed stack.
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` (role map and severity map) and its test fixtures;
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-react-page-props.ts` (`REACT_FIELD_SPECS.ListView`) and its "covers the legacy filterableFields shorthand" test;
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts:307`;
  - `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts:3114` and `:3149`, which still name the key as a checked position in `os explain` text;
  - `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`, in comments;
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts:237` and the `packages/objectql/src/metadata-diagnostics.test.ts` fixtures;
  - `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts` (`LIST_VIEW_NAME_LISTS.filterableFields`).

  The tree-scoped pin's RESIDUE set holds the four that spell it as an object key, and goes red when the follow-up deletes them.
- **Boundary: a react page.** A react `ListView` element's `filterableFields` prop lives in a react page's opaque `source` string, and no door parses that string against `ListViewSchema`. The lint still treats it as a field-bearing prop ("honored by the renderer"). Once objectui removes its reader, the prop becomes a silent no-op on react pages unless the react-props lint learns to refuse it. The boundary is stated in the schema comment and the ledger note.
- **objectui follow-up (the seat files it).** Re-read at the moved pin `12dc7b47`:
  - `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:3448` forwards the key;
  - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:4656` is the `filterFields` whitelist;
  - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:3124` forwards it, `:1030` keeps a key list, and `plugin-view/src/index.tsx:90` registers an input;
  - `types/src/objectql.ts:2625` and `:2966` declare it locally;
  - `types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:1300` reads `.shape.filterableFields` by reference.

  No export is removed and that member still exists as the tombstone, so the pinned objectui build compiles unchanged. The refusal flows into objectui's zod twin on the next pin bump.
- **ADR-0047 text is now stale.** Decision 1 says "`filterableFields` stays as the legacy shorthand; loaders auto-upgrade it to `userFilters.fields` entries". That auto-upgrade was never built, and the ruling now forbids it. Its own section 4 calls the alias "one-release courtesies, not commitments". An amendment line is a `docs/adr/**` (Tier H) edit outside this PR's surface. It is raised in the report as an open question for the seat.
- **Out-of-repo consumers: NOT MEASURED.** `@objectstack/spec` is published.
